items.text: Agrees on Germie Bernard as deep-league stash/YAC fit with McCarthy; Pittman out opens opportunity. Especially loves the fit.

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snaps, high target share on routes, Indy just gave up big to Henry. Smash RB spot.
Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization Week 1, high target share, 25+ touches recent. Elite volume.
Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; strong history with Wentz (18 PPG avg). Volume play.
Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL: Kamara expected back squeezes role; Week 1 points mostly receiving, underdog script bad for rushes.
